case_title: BAGGETTA AVA VS ARRICK ROBERT DVM OWNER PARK ANIMAL HOSPITAL

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $455.77 FILED BY BAGGETTA AVA AS TO DEFENDANT ARRICK ROBERT DVM OWNER PARK ANIMAL HOSPITAL ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-02-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 05
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT ARRICK ROBERT DVM OWNER PARK ANIMAL HOSPITAL

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BAGGETTA AVA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT ARRICK ROBERT DVM OWNER PARK ANIMAL HOSPITAL STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
